originalEntry.title: Replay video of painting the Mona Lisa
originalEntry.title_zh: 临摹蒙娜丽莎的过程回放
originalEntry.author: ehsanik
originalEntry.description: A 31-second replay of Opus painting the Mona Lisa stroke by stroke in JS Paint, asked for as a follow-up after it drove Chrome to paint it.
originalEntry.description_zh: 31 秒回放：Opus 先操控 Chrome 在 JS Paint 里一笔笔画出蒙娜丽莎，再按追问把过程做成视频。
originalEntry.prompt: Ok now can you make a video of exactly what you just did? Showing every mouse movement and changes?
originalEntry.prompt_zh: 好，现在你能把你刚才做的事原样做成一段视频吗？展示每一次鼠标移动和画面变化？
originalEntry.note: Author: the painting step took about 20 minutes.
originalEntry.note_zh: 作者称绘画环节用了约 20 分钟。
